releaseStatus.note: RAV 2.5.8 is the current public release. It fixes the Machine ID on Windows (it was unavailable there in 2.5.7, which blocked activation on Windows installations); the Machine ID is now derived from the installation's machine identifier on Windows, the hardware UUID on macOS and the machine-id file elsewhere, and existing keys are unaffected. 2.5.7 added the Machine ID row in the About window, the MCP rav_entitlement_status tool (56 tools total), file inspection rebuilt on RF Parser 2.5.14, and the timeline scrubber fixes.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV is a desktop Rive animation viewer and exporter with timeline, still-image, animated-image, live interaction recording, bundled verified encoders, and MCP access.
